Inground Pool Closing & Winterizing Services

Our inground pool closing and winterizing services are essential for maintaining the quality and longevity of your pool, especially for residents of Waterloo Region & Guelph, ON. Each service we provide is tailored to suit the unique needs of your pool and your personal preferences, ensuring your backyard oasis remains protected through the harsh winter months.

At Hipel Pools, our dedicated team is ready to guide you through every step of the pool closing process, from draining and covering to complete winterizing. We pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional customer experience, and our commitment to excellence is evident in every pool we prepare for winter.

Book Your Pool Closing
Inground Pool Closings

Pool Closing Packages

Check out our inground pool closing & winterizing packages and conveniently book your own pool closing directly on our website.

We Only Winterize Inground Pools With Winter Safety Covers

Top Choice

Inground Pool Closing WITH Safety Cover

400+hst
1. Lower pool water level 6"-8" below Skimmer
2. Blow out all pool lines and equipment (add antifreeze as required)
3. Install winterizing plugs & gizzmo in skimmer
4. Remove pool related deck equipment (ladder, handrails, fittings, etc)
5. Fall closing chemical kit is included (Algaecide, Stain & Scale, Oxidizer)
6. Shut off pool heater and gas supply valve
7. Install customer provided winter safety pool cover
  • We do not remove diving boards or pool slides
  • Removed equipment will be left near the pool for you to store away
  • All fittings and small equipment pieces will be stored near the mechanical pad or in the pump strainer basket
If your inground swimming pool is already equipped with a winter safety cover this package is for you!
